findings.claim: STS credential lifetime. The revised plan has `localstack ov-sync-env` post DurationSeconds=900, O4's faked-STS test asserts it is sent, and the live check asserts Expiration about 15 minutes out. SeaweedFS 4.48 accepts 900: the handler bounds are inclusive [900, MaxSessionLength=12h], and no per-role MaxSessionDuration is set, so nothing lowers or refuses it.
